summary: Verified auto-scrolling Gallery Carousel on Home page ('Escritório em imagens') using framer-motion. Measured X position of first .flex-none image over time: t=0s x=-367.93, t=3.5s x=-635.86 (Δ=-267.94), t=5.5s x=-790.05. Continuous leftward motion confirmed. 16 image slots present (8 unique duplicated). data-testid='gallery-carousel' present. No JS errors observed in console. Heading 'Um olhar pelo cotidiano do escritório' rendered correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GalleryCarousel component with framer-motion works. Auto-scroll verified via position sampling over 5.5s. Bug reported by user is FIXED.
rca of the issue: Previous CSS-only marquee did not animate reliably (likely due to keyframe/animation class purging or missing @keyframes definition in the built Tailwind CSS). Replacing with framer-motion animate={x:['0%','-50%']} runtime-driven animation resolves it since it uses transform via inline style updated by JS RAF loop; not dependent on CSS build.
